nodes.label: FD - Freight Difference (hidden accounting field)
nodes.rationale: FD is an internal field kept in the accounting ledger and Agent/Dalal ledger for true margin tracking, but is deliberately excluded from the printed Bilti so the customer-facing document does not disclose the internal freight difference.

nodes.label: LocalStorage-only prototype limitation
nodes.rationale: The prototype persists data only in the browser's local storage as a starting foundation; for real multi-user use across mobile/laptop/desktop with shared data it must be connected to a hosted database and authentication/API, but the UI and accounting workflow are already prepared for that future deployment.

nodes.label: Firm-scoped document/ledger inheritance
nodes.rationale: A single globally-selected state.firm is auto-attached (firm_id) to every new Loading Slip, Bilti, Agent/Owner Payment, and Receipt, and prints on every letterhead document, so the operator never has to re-select the firm per document.

nodes.label: Printable letterhead document styling (gr-doc)
nodes.rationale: Print views (Loading Slip, Bilti/GR, Receipt) are styled to resemble a real letterhead form rather than a raw data dump, sized for A4 printing via @media print rules, so users can 'Save as PDF' a professional-looking document to share on WhatsApp/email.

nodes.label: Hidden Freight Difference (FD)
nodes.rationale: FD (freight_difference) is captured on the Bilti form and stored for accounting / Agent-Dalal ledger use, but is explicitly excluded from the printed Bilti/GR document (marked no-print and called out in gr-note) because it represents an internal margin not meant to be shown to the consignor/consignee.
